plugins.description: Shrimad Bhagwatam Guide – Srila BV Narayan Goswami Maharaj. Ask any question from all 12 Cantos of Srimad-Bhagavatam, explained in the line of Sri Srimad Bhaktivedanta Narayana Gosvami Maharaja. Simple answers with Canto.Chapter.Verse, who is speaking to whom, and links to his free books on purebhakti.com, in your own language.

skills.name: ask-bhagavatam
skills.description: Answers devotees' questions from Srimad-Bhagavatam (all 12 Cantos) in the line of Sri Srimad Bhaktivedanta Narayana Gosvami Maharaja and the Gaudiya Vaisnava acaryas, with Canto.Chapter.Verse references, who is speaking to whom, and simple explanations in the user's own language. Use this skill whenever the user asks about Srimad-Bhagavatam, Bhagavata Purana, "Shrimad Bhagwat", "Bhagwat katha", a canto or skandha, a verse such as "SB 10.14.8" or "1.2.6", Sri Krishna's pastimes (Damodara, Govardhana, Rasa-lila, Venu-gita, Gopi-gita, Bhramara-gita), stories such as Dhruva, Prahlada, Ajamila, Gajendra, Bali, Kapila, Uddhava, Pariksit and Sukadeva, or wants a Bhagavatam class or katha prepared. Use it even when the user writes in Hindi, Hinglish, Bengali or any other language, and even if the word "Bhagavatam" is not used.
